rca_of_the_issue: LLM (claude-sonnet-4-6) does not always honour the interview_prep@1.0 prompt schema — the string 'STAR-style outline using only real CV facts' is sometimes materialised as a JSON object {situation, task, action, result}. The backend persists whatever JSON comes back (validate_tailored is not applied to prep) and PrepTab in the frontend renders `q.answer_outline` as a React child. When it's a dict, React throws 'Objects are not valid as a React child' and Emergent's runtime-error overlay hides the entire app. Mitigation applied: cleared the corrupted prep from demo's app so testers can reopen the drawer without crashing. Permanent fix: (1) backend — after llm_json returns, walk res.questions and coerce non-string answer_outline via `' · '.join(f'{k[0].upper()}: {v}' for k,v in ao.items())`; (2) frontend — render safely: `typeof q.answer_outline==='string' ? q.answer_outline : Object.entries(q.answer_outline).map(([k,v])=>`${k}: ${v}`).join('\n')`.
